The Police had no distance men for the One and Two Miles, so a One Mile was held, with Bob Boyden and Tom Morrell scoring for our hosts. Scott was an easy winner from Stan Eeles.

The chief feature of the race was the forward running of several of the younger school, particularly Stan Eeles who perhaps ran his best race to date—Stan has the makings of a real runner if he will get down to it, Fred Clay, John Brown, Bob Boyden, Norman Walker and Alf Heathfield.
Bob Boyden, who has been absent for some time, has recently had an addition to his family, another boy. Johnny Johnson, our "guest" member from Sheffield, was another who turned up on October 6th.
